subject: 2022 Medford Pride Planning and Inclusivity
overview: Members of the Medford Pride Planning Committee discussed the upcoming schedule of events and their commitment to creating a celebration focused on community and racial equity. The conversation addressed safety concerns, the history of Pride, and long-term goals for LGBTQ+ visibility in Medford.

items.title: Introductions and Motivations
items.summary: Committee members introduced themselves and shared their motivations for joining, highlighting the need for youth representation and a more inclusive atmosphere for trans people and people of color.

items.title: June Event Schedule
items.summary: The committee detailed the remaining June schedule, featuring a queer art show, a transgender 101 workshop, a skate party at City Hall, and a final celebration at Andrews Field on June 26.

items.title: Comparison with Boston Pride and Corporate Sponsorship
items.summary: Members discussed differentiating Medford Pride from the dissolved Boston Pride by prioritizing small local businesses over large corporate sponsorships to avoid commercialization.

items.title: Safety and Police Presence
items.summary: The group debated the role of police at Pride events, weighing the historical tensions between law enforcement and the queer community against current efforts to de-emphasize police uniforms and visibility.

items.title: Future Vision and Business Engagement
items.summary: The committee proposed future goals including geographic expansion of events across Medford, fundraising for trans organizations, and a safe-space sticker campaign for local businesses.
